item.title: 'This neighborhood is grieving': Vigil honors 3-year-old killed in Delta Township shooting
item.description: A community in Lansing, Michigan came together to mourn the loss of a 3-year-old child who was killed in a drive-by shooting, and to support the three adults who were injured in the same incident.

item.title: Pedestrian struck and killed by car near Lansing Airport
item.description: A 23-year-old man was killed after being hit by a car early Saturday morning near the Lansing International Airport, and police are currently investigating the incident.
